results.title: 8 foods Indians changed so much that they became completely different dishes
results.description: What happened next was very Indian: the newcomers were absorbed, altered and loaded with local flavours until they became almost unrecognisable from their original forms. Some of today’s most beloved Indian foods are, in fact, stories of culinary reinvention.

results.title: WION Iconic Tourism Summit and Awards 2026: Kapil Bhatia to Ustad Amjad Ali Khan; Check full list of winners here
results.description: Just a few days ahead of World Tourism Day, observed annually on September 27 to foster awareness of tourism's social, cultural, political and economic value, the WION Iconic Tourism Summit and Awards 2026, presented by VFS Global in association with Red Hat Communications, was held in New Delhi on September 23 at ITC Maurya.
